I saved Ilse's correction and replied to her in a thread under her message in #north-random.

- **Saved:** a note in the knowledge base that Brackenwater Freight Co.'s next renewal is 10 June. It replaces the date she posted in #north-team this morning, and it records where the correction came from. The note didn't get added to an account page because Brackenwater doesn't have one yet. It's saved as a standalone fact, and the save result marked it world-visible.
- **Reply:** I told her it's noted and that I changed nothing else.

She said no action was needed, so I didn't edit or comment on her original #north-team post. I also didn't read #north-team or look up her earlier correction (she said "again"). A renewal date isn't a finance figure, so no approval was needed.
